key_insight: Among the three spray distances tested, 190 mm produced the lowest-porosity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance can improve coating integrity and corrosion protection for DSS 2205 components exposed to acidic environments.
method: D-gun spray Cr₃C₂–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180 and 190 mm.
Examine coating morphology and porosity using SEM.
Evaluate corrosion in room-temperature 1 M H₂SO₄ using OCP, impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarization.
evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm; the 190 mm coating had a corrosion rate of 0.113 mm/year versus 2.60 mm/year for uncoated DSS 2205.
watch_item: The reported optimum applies to the tested distances and laboratory electrolyte; performance under industrial temperatures, flow and long-term exposure requires validation.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
